WHAT MAKES CASUAL WEAR FOR MEN SO AWESOME?

May say that adopting the latest trends in fashion is integral to any fashion conscious individual. Well, that does hold true to a certain extent as it doesn’t comprise the complete picture. Many wish to look good yet don’t want to stick to formal wear or blindly follow the current trends.

For some, their fashion choices are aimed at building better impressions on people they meet in their everyday life. If flashy is not your idea of standing out in the crowd, casual outfits for men can be the answer to your search for simple, impactful outfits.

CASUAL WEAR FOR MEN - THE SECRET TO YOUR CONFIDENCE

Whether you are hitting a party, heading for a date or just spending a casual day at work, casual wear serves a purpose. The purpose is to create a confident image of yours without sacrificing the much-needed comfort. With the impressive range of casual wear for men on Myntra, pulling off that cool image will not seem like much of a task. Here are some of the popular style choices often pulled off with casual wear for men.

The casual alternative to dress shirts and sports shirts are simple apparel with a polished image. There are many options to choose from due to its massive variety of patterns, colours and textures. If you wish to follow the current trend, go for a long-sleeved sports shirt with a slimmer fit. But we would recommend trying out other varieties of fits that suit your body type and style as well.

Those into jackets, consider trying out casual jackets. Available in a variety of colours, textures and fits, they pair well with chinos, shorts and jeans. Our personal favourite style is to wear a casual jacket with a slim fit T-shirt, or team it up with a vest, shirt and tie for a dressier look.

We now shift our focus to bottom wear. Your choice of bottom wear highly depends on your requirements. When it comes to casual jeans for men, they can either be pleated or flat-fronted. If jeans are your choice of the moment, well-fitted, dark wash jeans should seal the deal. These go well with light coloured men’s kurtas. For those willing to experiment, try out chinos in popular variants like chambray, cotton or linen. Avoid shorts for the outdoors as they only gel well with the gym look.
